# XHelpers Pro 1.0.12 (27)
- AI Usage: the AI meter can also sit in the menu bar as its own item, and clicking it opens the hover card. Turn it on with the Menu bar checkbox in the card's title bar or in the hover card settings; ⌘-drag it off the menu bar to turn it off. The card's Details button opens the AI Usage window. - AI Usage: a Codex subscription whose weekly timer has not started is flagged, with a note to use it to start the timer. Menu rows under the hover card no longer light up or take clicks. - Uninstall: the steps list shows only steps with work to do, grouped and coloured by kind. Failure notes, step status and the plan read more clearly, a draft session can be discarded, and a protected app no longer offers a Continue that cannot finish. - Software Update: choosing Check for Updates while an update is already open brings that update forward instead of a stuck "Checking" window.
## Also in 1.0.12
- AI Usage: a Claude account no longer stays at "Sign-in expired" after a Claude Code update removes the version it was set up with; automatic and manual Repair work for it again. - Keep Mac Awake: timers for 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, or 24 hours, and Custom… for any number of days, hours, and minutes. The Custom… window shows when the Mac can sleep again as you type, and the menu names the day when a timer ends after today. The chosen timer stays checked after a restart. - AI Usage: the hover card grows to fit its accounts and scrolls only when the screen has no more room. - Audio Player: the playback buttons are easier to read, the More menu keeps the same items and dims the ones that do not apply, "Clear Up Next" is now "Clear Rest of Queue", Playback Details and the Queue share one summary, and the volume panel's Output button names the current device. - Video player: an empty queue says to drop videos on it, Queue is an on/off toggle, queued videos show their length, and videos that fail to play show an orange warning. - License window: every button, field, status line, and card border is readable in light and dark mode and in every license state. Activate lights up as soon as a key is typed, the window shows when a promotion ends, and Buy License follows the website's current promotion. - Status menu: the Account row's icon shows whether you are signed in, signed out, or need attention. Music & Playlists is labelled "Music & Playlists (Tonale)…" and shows Tonale's own icon in the menu row and the install panel, which gained an icon tile, tinted callouts, and a filled primary button. - Keep Mac Awake resumes after a restart. - AI Usage: the hover card says each fact once, shows bare percentages, puts the plan badge beside the pill with green reset counts, uses one date shape with aligned countdown and percent columns, and keeps each account's height steady while it refreshes. The menu-bar mark can be icon-only. The window pins limit resets above each card's actions, keeps its toolbar on one row in longer languages, names accounts in the app's language, and shows Claude's saved reset grants and weekly session-limit reset as well as Grok's limit-reset credits. The bundled collector is updated to CodexBar 0.65.1. - Browser sign-in for XHelpers Pro returns through its page on xintechllc.com. - Shortcuts: default shortcut keys come from the localized System Settings tables, and the conflict warning names the macOS shortcut a key collides with and detects global shortcuts already taken by other apps. - System Tweaks: a card that turns off press-and-hold accents, and the shortest key-repeat delay macOS accepts. - Audio Player: the speaker sits beside More with the transport centred, the queue fits its rows, the output device is chosen beside the volume, the effects window opens beside the player, Queue information is back, and the More menu is tidier. In-house effects load in a sandbox, and a failed audio unit no longer crashes the player. - Video player: matches the Audio Player's look and opens its Open panel as a sheet on its window. - Text Editor preserves rich clipboard content. - Translate the new interface text across all 25 supported translation languages, including the Window Outline rename and corrected Audio Effects terms.
Xin account features remain disabled in this release.
